objective: Test whether exact single-residual support-lattice ownership feasibility E1 decomposes into the rank-local rules R+G+H, and whether F(E1(q)) equals RFGH(q), across the frozen 4x4-k4 training case and four fresh bounded holdouts.
distinction: E1 is the existing exact single-residual feasibility operator; it is unrelated to the user's height-XOR coordinate X_h.
anti_circularity: R/G/H definitions are frozen before these holdouts
E1 uses support-lattice ownership feasibility only, no W/D/L or first-win result oracle
equality is checked on exact transformed q representations, not only class counts
